title: write_config materialises defaults into config.json, so writing a default stops it being a default and the project silently stops tracking the tool
body:
**Found by cc while landing `lang` (`b60f9ebb`); written to `vc/inbox.cc.md` at 23:15Z and REPRODUCED INDEPENDENTLY by vc on a separate fixture before filing.** Not a blocker, not new with `lang`, and **cc deliberately did not fix it** -- it is `project.rs` behaviour reaching every future writer, and the remedy is a trade-off rather than a tidy-up.

**DRIVEN BY vc.** A `config.json` carrying four keys, run through `intent3 lang init rust` (rc=0), came back carrying seven:

    before: a_block_v3_does_not_model, intent_version, languages, project_name
    after:  + author, intent_dir, todo

`todo` arrived as `{"window_hours": 24}`. **`Config` uses `#[serde(default)]` with NO `skip_serializing_if` on `project_name`, `author`, `intent_dir` and `todo`; only `project_id` is skipped when absent.**

**COUNT DIFFERS FROM cc's AND THE DIFFERENCE IS EXPLAINED RATHER THAN PAPERED OVER:** cc measured four keys in, EIGHT out; vc measured four in, SEVEN out. vc's fixture already carried `project_name`, which is one of the four materialised, so only three were added. **Same property, different arithmetic. A count that disagrees is worth naming, because the alternative is two figures for one measurement and no record of why.**

**THE HALF THAT IS CORRECT AND WORKS, CONFIRMED IN THE SAME RUN:** the unmodelled block `a_block_v3_does_not_model` survived **byte-for-byte**, exactly as `extra`'s doc promises. **This is not a block being dropped. It is the opposite direction -- a DEFAULT BEING FROZEN.**

**THE HAZARD, IN ONE LINE: WRITING A DEFAULT STOPS IT BEING A DEFAULT.** `todo.window_hours: 24` is a real tunable with a real default. Once materialised, that project is pinned at 24 and **stops tracking the tool** -- silently, with nothing in the file distinguishing a value that was CHOSEN from one that was MATERIALISED. **If the default ever changes, every project that has run any config-writing verb is on the old value and nothing reports it.** The fleet is 17 projects.

**IT IS A REGRESSION AGAINST v2, WHICH DID NOT DO THIS.** `add_project_language` used `jq` to touch the array and left the rest of the file alone.

**INERT TODAY AND THAT IS THE WHOLE DIFFICULTY.** Every value written is the value the tool would have used, so there is no observable difference now and no test that can fail. **The entire cost is deferred to the first default change, at which point the divergence is already installed everywhere and is silent by construction.**

**REMEDY IS A DESIGN CALL, NOT A FIX, WHICH IS WHY IT IS FILED RATHER THAN DONE.** `skip_serializing_if` on the four is not free: a project that legitimately sets `author: ""` would lose the declaration, so minimal-write and explicit-write are a genuine trade-off. A third shape exists -- **record provenance, so a materialised value is distinguishable from a chosen one** -- and it is the only one that keeps both properties, at the cost of a schema change.

**SEVERITY IS vc's READ AND NOT A RULING.** cc offered LOW-to-MEDIUM. Filed MEDIUM on the ground that the blast radius is every project that ever runs a config-writing verb, and the failure is silent at the moment it matters.
